interface.longDescription: Bring your organization's System Model into ChatGPT and Codex. Search connected code, tickets, pull requests, documents and people; investigate dependencies and change impact; apply your organization's rules; and save authorized decisions as durable memories. Discover and use live operations across your connected services, manage Bonez agents, and inspect or configure environments with your existing permissions. Requires a Bonez account and an organization with indexed data. Available records and actions depend on your account's access, configured integrations and runtime support. Some environment actions require an interactive Bonez session. This public package connects to Bonez Cloud. Local session capture, automatic recall hooks and local plugin-building utilities remain available through the repository's local installations.

positive.description: Navigate indexed code relationships. Setup: payzeno-showcase-pilot-01/payzeno-showcase-pilot-01 at seed bbbd0722d407142c06af528941b01161e81f097f, with ledger.py and test_ledger.py indexed.
positive.prompt: Who calls Ledger.credit in payzeno-showcase-pilot-01/payzeno-showcase-pilot-01/ledger.py, and which tests cover it? I want to understand the impact before changing it.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the actual Ledger.credit symbol using search. Discover caller and test queries with system_model_schema and run them with the resolved path and repository. Fetch source evidence as needed. The seeded callers include test_first_credit, test_distinct_events_with_equal_amounts and test_invalid_amount_does_not_change_balance. Describe heuristic edges as candidates; distinguish indexed test relationships from runtime coverage, and missing idempotency coverage from proof of safety. Do not invent symbols or tests.

positive.description: Authorized personal memory with preflight and readback. Setup: synthetic PayZeno reviewer account has bonez:memory scope and indexed ledger.py. This writes one personal test note. After the rehearsal, close the memory with its returned ID; do not delete source records.
positive.prompt: Remember my personal code-review preference for payzeno-showcase-pilot-01/payzeno-showcase-pilot-01/ledger.py: show repo-qualified caller names and test filenames before recommending a change. I authorize saving this preference for me only; do not share it with the organization.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve and fetch the exact repository-qualified ledger.py; preserve payzeno-showcase-pilot-01/payzeno-showcase-pilot-01/ledger.py verbatim in the saved content. Call memory_save op=remember preflight=true with scope=personal, kind=preference, basis=stated, a short reason and the resolved anchor. Inspect similar matches; only equivalent active or pending personal memories prevent a new save. Save once with preflight=false when needed, then fetch the returned ID. Verify content, anchors, personal scope and actual state. Report any mismatch as failure, not success. Never request unrelated personal information or broaden scope. Honor host permission prompts.
